text: Matt Hilder, Acting Director, Housing Secretariat, Aisha Silim, Manager, Policy Program Planning, Housing Secretariat, and senior City staff will provide a presentation, outlining a proposed by-law aimed at preventing renovictions in the city. Discussion and consultation on the implementation of the proposed by-law will follow.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee: 1. Requested that the Maintaining Housing working group consult on the draft renovictions by-law to offer their recommendations and advice.
